verdict: Existing native M0/M4 pairs support many target-owned visible/nonvisible 2D labels without GT as model input. Global area is large but fixed sparse query crops may contain little natural hidden support. The next test must supervise target ownership and preserve outside-support negatives, rather than relabel every nonvisible pixel as semantic external occlusion.

observed_data.counts_definition: Native PNG instance-pixel occurrences summed over5203 rows. Multiple target instances can share RGB; 8 ROIs overlap; these are not independent images, unique scene pixels, or new independent visibility events.
observed_data.subset_evidence: M4 subset M0 sealed for all5203; bounded metadata-SHA8-row replay found0 differences in native areas/subset/HW. SYNTH threshold raw>127; BOP raw>0.
observed_data.sample_limit: 2 rows per source/split, chosen before masks/RGB by SHA(id), not representative prevalence estimate. Public TRAIN16 ROIs contain3 covered cells at9x9,356 visible,640 outside; VAL16 contain8 covered,356 visible,932 outside. Both sampled SYNTH TRAIN rows have0 covered crop pixels although full TRAIN has2,014,541. Do not silently replace these by occlusion-rich examples.

separate_targets.dense_visible_pixel: V(p)=M4(p): target-owned visible pixel in this source instance, not any foreground object. Other objects are negative for this target.
separate_targets.dense_expected_support: A(p)=M0(p): isolated-target same-view rendered 2D support/silhouette. Called mask_amodal/full in original files; it is not all3D surface, not virtual-corner physical membership, not a guarantee of human semantic visibility.
separate_targets.dense_nonvisible_expected_support: Cmask(p)=M0(p)&~M4(p), source conditional mask/render/depth occlusion proxy. This is target support missing from visible mask, not a learned causal E label or self S.
separate_targets.dense_outside_expected_support: Omask(p)=~M0(p). Distinct from Cmask; may be background, another object, a hole, or area outside isolated target. Never semantic E/S merely because M0/M4 are0.
separate_targets.query_pixel_presence: At p=floor(q+.5), M4(p) is exact query-pixel presence. It can differ from the V76/V77/V78 reference-local support teacher; do not use pixel metrics to declare that task solved.
separate_targets.reference_local_support: Existing V76 strong3x3-first/footprint ratio VISIBLE/COVERED/U remains an independent GT-only target around fixed virtual r8; q/r/L/native order unchanged. Center mask0 need not imply local support COVERED.
separate_targets.human_D_E_S: Human annotated real reference/slot visibility remains separate evaluation. Dense source labels cannot establish human D/E/S correctness, semantic S, deployed native association, or full goal completion.
separate_targets.self_proxy: convex_self_visible_proxy1=mayvisible,0=selfhidden,-1unknown stays separate; never merge with dense Cmask or use as GT mask input.

loss_only_mapping.input_contract: Keep exactly existing source RGB96/valid, P3 native65x9x9, target RGB128/valid, context42 from original q8/L/box. No GT mask/ref/pose/anchor/teacherID/sourceID/model-selected query enters forward.
loss_only_mapping.GT_coordinates: Map M0/M4 at the same native centers as the chosen output resolution. For existing native9 map: p=q+(i-4)*L/9; for RGB96 map p=q+((i+.5)/96-.5)*L. Nearest label index=floor(p+.5). Require continuous and rounded in-image validity; out-of-image has ignored loss, not visible0/covered.
loss_only_mapping.no_recenter: Never move q to a positive mask pixel/reference, change L/box, reorder slots, or make an extra GT-targeted query crop. Labels can supervise existing input positions only.
loss_only_mapping.dense_vs_primary_admission: Existing support U/miss/invalid policy remains zero support loss. Dense mask labels at valid pixels are a different auxiliary target, not a justification to convert those support labels to COVERED. Any broader auxiliary sampling beyond the existing batch is a separate protocol change.
loss_only_mapping.GT_mask_admission_only: GT M0 can define positive/negative loss targets and reporting cohorts; it must not select predicted masks, target instance prompt, model branch, input feature/crop, query position, or inference threshold.
loss_only_mapping.boundary: Native render/depth-alignment boundaries are noisy source proxies. Preserve and report boundary/interior strata; any ignore band/softlabel policy must be fixed from source TRAIN before a future fit, never selected by current223/VAL results.
loss_only_mapping.evaluation: Report separate visible-mask and expected-support-map quality, V/Cmask/O confusion and areas, and unchanged reference-local support metrics/pairboth. Preserve outside-support denominator; do not report Cmask precision as semantic E precision.

ownership_and_identifiability.same_RGB_multiple_instances: YCB RGB is reused for several instance rows with different target masks. A decoder must condition on the unchanged input target crop/queryset/instance proposal. An unconditioned full-frame foreground map has contradictory target-owned labels.
ownership_and_identifiability.rough_target_crop_mixing: The GT-free target128 crop is inferred from q8 min/max and can include occluders/other objects or miss the intended target. It is contextual evidence, not certified target identity. Do not replace with GTbbox/M0 at train or inference.
ownership_and_identifiability.same_input_collision: A later actual label-cache preflight should hash all forward inputs+query context and record different target-owned dense labels for identical effective inputs. Wrong-instance or indistinguishable input-target associations remain U/not-admitted for the intended conditional target; do not fit contradictions or choose a target with GT at inference.
ownership_and_identifiability.amodal_inference_limit: Occluded expected support is not always identifiable from local RGB. An amodal output can learn source priors and can hallucinate; dense supervision does not prove observability or actual pallet transfer.
ownership_and_identifiability.virtual_reference_scope: Virtual cuboid native0..7 do not have to lie on mesh surfaces. Dense support masks are auxiliary appearance supervision; absence at a virtual vertex is not a reason to block learning, move that vertex/query, or replace the task with physical corner detection.

minimal_next_test_proposal.hypothesis: Sparse eight-reference binary labels leave target-owned visible/support structure underconstrained; dense same-crop V/A supervision may improve natural occlusion discrimination while preserving visible recall and outside-support negatives.
minimal_next_test_proposal.one_bounded_candidate: Use the existing V77/V76 spatial fused feature tensor24x9x9, add one1x1 Conv24to2 auxiliary map decoder (50 parameters) for visible V and expected support A. Keep its support classifier, six forward inputs, source split, initialization, batch96 sampled query IDs, primary support labels, seed/budget and naturalVAL4strata selector unchanged. Fixed auxiliary weight/normalization must be separately preregistered before any fit; no choice is authorized here.
minimal_next_test_proposal.why_this_is_small: Existing source P3/RGB caches and the current24x9x9 fused representation are available; no new backbone/source image/crop/query or GT-derived prompt is required. Label maps would be GT-only. This tests additional supervision within the specialist spatial candidate, not DINO causal contribution.
minimal_next_test_proposal.DINO_cache_constraint: V78 stores only pooled center/global/target384-D vectors, not16x16 tokens. A spatial dense decoder cannot truthfully be attached to those vectors as though coordinates were preserved. A DINO dense-map test would require a separately authorized spatial feature extraction/protocol; it is not free reuse of the sealed pooled cache.
minimal_next_test_proposal.pre_fit_required_inventory: Before committing a future fit, count9x9 V/Cmask/O and all-empty maps in the actual unchanged TRAIN batch pools and VAL crops. Freeze class/valid-pixel normalization from TRAIN. Global full-image mask mass alone is insufficient evidence for usable natural-C crop supervision.
minimal_next_test_proposal.success_or_no_go: Compare frozen support criterion and natural V/C/O tradeoff plus paired controls, not dense-pixel accuracy alone. If ownership collisions/misassociation remain or natural C crops contain too little evidence, report no-go/inconclusive; do not mine extra GT-centered patches, retune radius/threshold, select another checkpoint by source gate, or enter current evaluation automatically.
minimal_next_test_proposal.not_an_objective_fix_proof: Auxiliary gradient competition or stronger target conditioning may help or hurt; this review supplies feasibility, not a claim that missing dense loss caused the V78 failure.
